description: KOCJUK crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group P 21/n. Reported CIF formula moiety: C70 H66 Eu2 N4 O20 Zn2,3(C1 H4 O1),4(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors; Zn2 (Zn) has 3 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.395-3.397 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 100.65-103.90°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula C70H66Zn2N4Eu2O20·3MeOH·3H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 6 OAc (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
